programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: After receiving an inheritance from his aunt, a man looks to retire early and fulfill his dream of owning a luxurious bed and breakfast; with a substantial budget, David has some sensational options with casitas and cacti in Tucson, Arizona.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: David is on a journey to meet a California couple looking to make a fresh start in the Champagne region of France; it's a romantic and gastronomical tour of French countryside as David searches for a dream holiday home just outside of Paris.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A writer and director in Los Angeles looks to live his best life with a new place in Palm Springs, California; he wants a large turnkey home at a low price, but his friend and agent both think that's a dream that may be pure La La Land.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A girl and a guy disagree on what to buy in Pennsylvania; a first-generation Italian-American wife doesn't mind spending for a turnkey home in a great location, but her frugal Portuguese-American husband prefers to buy low and renovate.
